text: Vera is running to the Valve Hut! Press T, type 14:00 and watch.
You have the key! Find Vera (V): tell her the gauge, then give the key.
You have the key! Vera wants proof: read the gauge (g) after 11:00.
Tomas left with the key. Ask Kai (K) for secrets at the Mill.
Tomas is gone. Sneak in the bar's back door (x), search the shelf (&).
Too late, Tomas left town. Press T, type 14:00, and catch him next loop.
Tomas (T) has the key! Catch him before his 10:20 bus and ask.
Who has the key? Ask Ilse (I) at the Pharmacy about her dad, Oskar.
Tell Vera (V) the gauge reading. Cafe in the morning, Town Hall at noon.
Water is rising. Press T, type 11:00, then check the gauge (g) again.
It's after 11:00. Check the gauge (g) by the dam again!
Vera trusts numbers. Check the water gauge (g), top-left by the dam.
Letters are people. Walk next to Vera (V), the dam expert, and press E.
